```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The need for working class revolution in our lifetime is urgent.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"World resources should be used for the wellbeing of all people.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Oligarchs enrich themselves at the expense of lives and the planet.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The working class is exploited by the capitalist class.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Global South is exploited by the Global North.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Imperialism and colonialism continue to appropriate the bodies and ecologies of the peoples of the world to develop the excesses of Western society.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Liberation movements resist the poverty and war the U.S. government imposes upon them, both at home and abroad.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The world system ruled by 20th century capitalism is ending.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"A meaningful role can be taken in the transformation if a parallel struggle is engaged in, stitching together diverse social forces to organize a mass front against global imperialism and domestic carceral fascism.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Organizing aims to erode relationships of domination and build collective power.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"A shared destiny can be charted in unity.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
